highest_evidence.value: 前のとほとんど変わってない、、画像も入ってないし

diagnosis_summary: Issue #119/#124 repaired traceability and structural variant breadth but did not make premium perception the final runtime/QA authority. Production can now be structurally different while remaining perceptually sparse, restrained and visually related.

root_causes.name: Structural fidelity was mistaken for perceptual fidelity
evidence: Issue #124 can vary continuation variants, clone signatures and silhouettes while Shun still reads the result as almost unchanged.
Issue #126 explicitly centered its PASS on resolved clone/skeleton divergence.
root_causes.failure: The renderer proves mechanism identity but not benchmark-level perceptual effect.
root_causes.recovery: Add metadata-blind perceptual mechanism acceptance for every selected variant and whole page.

root_causes.name: Media remained an evidence/asset binding concern instead of a page-level art-direction medium
evidence: Exactly 2 img elements in each of 9 owner HTML pages.
Most Page Spine continuation media_arc entries are copy_evidence_only after hero/local media.
root_causes.failure: Images can technically exist while feeling absent because they do not create sustained media rhythm, transitions, context or world-building.
root_causes.recovery: Introduce Media Narrative Plan with scene role, prominence intent, crop/layering, transition role and mobile re-art-direction; no arbitrary universal image count.

root_causes.name: Page Art Direction Spine propagated semantics more strongly than public pixel grammar
evidence: All pages reuse the same sans/serif variables and six animation declarations; only three stylesheet hashes occur across nine pages.
Contact-sheet comparison shows new body geometry but a retained restrained border/ledger/rail vocabulary and sparse media.
root_causes.failure: Spine coordinates what modules mean, but not enough of what the page feels like at first glance.
root_causes.recovery: Make the Spine pixel-authoritative for macro type relationship, media rhythm, density/contrast arc, material language, edge behavior, authored focal scenes and mobile transformation.

root_causes.name: Benchmark qualities were compressed into Pattern IDs and continuation names
evidence: Issue #44 deep annotations describe imagery dominating early, continuous editorial worlds, immersive material crops, sharply changing density and mobile editorial sequencing.
Issue #124 implements named route/evidence/compare continuations but does not reproduce those perceptual qualities consistently.
root_causes.failure: Pattern traceability survived, but sensory/editorial force was reduced to component geometry.
root_causes.recovery: Production Variant acceptance must carry visible benchmark qualities, not only mechanism names and DOM identities.

root_causes.name: Aoi review optimized for cross-sample uniqueness before absolute quality
evidence: Issue #126 PASS repeatedly cites clone groups being resolved, sample-to-sample differences and variant continuations.
A page can be different from another weak page and still not look premium.
root_causes.failure: Non-clone became a proxy for quality.
root_causes.recovery: Aoi v2 must judge each page blind and individually for premium gestalt before any cross-sample uniqueness check; failure cannot be rescued by divergence.

root_causes.name: Rejected-baseline delta was not a hard human gate
evidence: Shun's immediate reaction was '前のとほとんど変わってない'.
Issue #124 evidence proves differences but did not require a metadata-blind first-glance escape from the owner-rejected visual lineage.
root_causes.failure: Additional sections/classes can pass while the overall visual identity remains familiar.
root_causes.recovery: Add Rejected Baseline Delta Gate: current vs latest owner-rejected 1440/390 actual renders, judged on macro silhouette, type, media rhythm, material language and focal sequence.

root_causes.name: Owner evidence integrity was not cryptographically closed
evidence: Within Artifact 10929939766, current owner_html_bundle and nested issue121_base owner_html_bundle are byte-identical across all 9 cases, including production manifests.
root_causes.failure: The packaged baseline cannot independently prove before/after owner HTML and risks reviewer confusion about which HTML was actually judged.
root_causes.recovery: Bind render input HTML hash, screenshot hash, owner-delivery HTML hash and frozen baseline hash in one evidence manifest; fail if current and baseline provenance collide.

research_reality.source: Issue #44 300 Discovery / 100 Strong / 60 Deep research closure
benchmark_visible_qualities: real media can dominate the early page and carry service expectation
editorial photography can form a continuous cultural/world-building authority, not a decorative slot
strong pages alternate immersive low-density scenes with denser practical/evidence scenes
material/ritual/detail crops can create sensory continuity
desktop grids should re-author into intentional mobile editorial sequences, not generic stacks
same-family distinctness depends heavily on hero silhouette, typography, media framing, whitespace rhythm, material grammar and screenshot-level gestalt
research_reality.production_gap: These qualities exist in research evidence but are not yet runtime-hard acceptance conditions.

not_the_solution: declaring premium because clone signatures diverge
